sources.name: DriveBC HighwayCams list (BC Data Catalogue dataset bc-highwaycams, webcams.csv)
sources.licence: BC Data Catalogue record (https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/api/3/action/package_show?id=bc-highwaycams, HTTP 200 read 2026-11-22): license_title "Open Government Licence - British Columbia", description "A list of the locations, web addresses and attributes regarding Ministry owned highway web cameras." OGL-BC (https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=A519A56BC2BF44E4A008B33FCF527F61, HTTP 200): "... non-exclusive licence to use the Information, including for commercial purposes, subject to the terms below"; free to "Copy, modify, publish, translate, adapt, distribute or otherwise use the Information in any medium, mode or format for any lawful purpose"; condition: acknowledge the source with the Information Provider's attribution statement and, where possible, link to the licence; exemption: "third party rights the Information Provider is not authorized to licence". The licence covers the LIST (camera id, name, position, highway, web address). Whether the camera JPEG itself is covered is NOT stated, so image display, caching and redistribution stay unverified and we only link out. The importer refuses to run if the record's license_title is not exactly the OGL-BC title.
sources.statusReason: quoted OGL-BC text permits use of the Information including for commercial purposes with attribution; applies to the camera list only, images unverified (link-out only)
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - British Columbia (https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=A519A56BC2BF44E4A008B33FCF527F61); camera list from DriveBC HighwayCams, BC Data Catalogue
sources.imageStatus: unverified: image display, caching and redistribution not stated; link-out only

sources.name: Fintraffic Digitraffic weather cameras (tie.digitraffic.fi/api/weathercam/v1/stations)
sources.licence: Digitraffic terms of service (https://www.digitraffic.fi/en/terms-of-service/, HTTP 200 read 2026-11-23): "Fintraffic's open data is licensed under the Creative Commons 4.0 By license. It gives the right to distribute, remix, tweak, and build upon our data, even commercially, as long as you credit the source for the original creation." Attribution example on the same page: "Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY"; the page also asks for a link to the licence and a note when the material was changed. The sentence speaks of Fintraffic's "open data" in general: whether the camera PICTURES are covered is NOT stated, so image display, caching and redistribution stay unverified and we only link out. Usage rules (https://www.digitraffic.fi/en/support/instructions/): gzip required (406 without it), weather camera images limited to 60 requests per minute per IP without the Digitraffic-User header (more with it); the importer sends the header "Digitraffic-User: NearbyCams-build" (no personal data) and stops if the two phrases "Creative Commons 4.0 By" and "even commercially" are no longer on the terms page.
sources.statusReason: quoted text: CC 4.0 BY open data, "even commercially", credit required; applies to the station list, pictures unverified (link-out only)
sources.attribution: Source: Fintraffic / digitraffic.fi, license CC 4.0 BY (https://www.digitraffic.fi/en/terms-of-service/)
sources.imageStatus: unverified: image display, caching and redistribution not stated; link-out only

sources.name: Camera de circulation, MTMD Quebec (Donnees Quebec dataset camera-de-circulation, WFS GeoJSON)
sources.licence: Donnees Quebec dataset record (https://www.donneesquebec.ca/recherche/api/3/action/package_show?id=camera-de-circulation, HTTP 200 read 2026-11-23): license_id "cc-by", license_title "Attribution (CC-BY 4.0)", license_url https://www.donneesquebec.ca/licence/#cc-by; the 7 resources carry no licence of their own. Licence page (https://www.donneesquebec.ca/licence/, HTTP 200 read 2026-11-23), CC BY variant: "Cette licence permet à d’autres personnes de distribuer, remixer, arranger et adapter votre œuvre, même à des fins commerciales, tant qu’on vous attribue le crédit de la création originale en citant votre nom." (this licence lets others distribute, remix, arrange and adapt, even for commercial purposes, as long as the original is credited); the same page says this variant is the default for every dataset. The licence covers the LIST (camera id, description, position, link). The links go to quebec511.info video pages, which answered our request with a Cloudflare bot-check page (HTTP 403, header Cf-Mitigated: challenge) on 2026-11-23: we do not work around that, never request those pages, and whether the pictures or video are covered is NOT stated, so image display, caching and redistribution stay unverified and we only link out. The importer stops if the record's license_id is not "cc-by".
sources.statusReason: quoted text: CC BY allows reuse even for commercial purposes with credit; dataset record says cc-by; applies to the camera list only, pictures unverified (link-out only)
sources.attribution: Contains data from the Ministere des Transports et de la Mobilite durable du Quebec, Donnees Quebec, licence CC-BY 4.0 (https://www.donneesquebec.ca/licence/#cc-by)
sources.imageStatus: unverified: image display, caching and redistribution not stated; link-out only; link host blocks automated checks

sources.name: Traffic Cameras, City of Toronto Open Data (CKAN datastore, dataset traffic-cameras)
sources.licence: Dataset record (https://ckan0.cf.opendata.inter.prod-toronto.ca/api/3/action/package_show?id=traffic-cameras, HTTP 200 read 2026-11-23): license_id "open-government-licence-toronto". Licence page (https://open.toronto.ca/open-data-licence/, HTTP 200 read 2026-11-23): "The Information Provider grants you a worldwide, royalty-free, perpetual, non-exclusive licence to use the Information, including for commercial purposes, subject to the terms below." and "Copy, modify, publish, translate, adapt, distribute or otherwise use the Information in any medium, mode or format for any lawful purpose." Condition: acknowledge the source by the attribution statement the provider specifies and, where possible, link to the licence; the dataset specifies none, so the licence page statement applies: "Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto." Exemptions on the same page: personal information, third party rights the provider cannot licence, the provider's names, crests and logos, and "Information subject to other intellectual property rights". The licence covers the LIST (camera number, roads, position, picture address). The dataset notes say the pictures are "displayed on the City's website"; they do not say whether the picture files are "Information" under this licence, so image display, caching and redistribution stay unverified and we only link out. Feed access: the CKAN datastore_search API (the portal robots.txt, https://ckan0.cf.opendata.inter.prod-toronto.ca/robots.txt, Allows /api/ and Disallows the /dataset/*/resource/*/download/* file path, so that path is not used); the picture host opendata.toronto.ca has no robots.txt of its own (HTTP 302 to www.toronto.ca, whose robots.txt names no /transportation/ path). The importer stops if the record's license_id changes or the two phrases "including for commercial purposes" and "Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence" leave the licence page.
sources.statusReason: quoted text: licence to use the Information "including for commercial purposes", attribution required; applies to the camera list, pictures unverified (link-out only)
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Toronto (https://open.toronto.ca/open-data-licence/)
